title: Brand mark · Introduction
slide_intent: Explain how a local community can identify itself within an international movement. A reader needs to see both affiliations at first contact.
strategic_value: A common symbol and logotype can convey continuity while the italic program name identifies the local organization.
demonstration: Labeled drawings compare the international mark with the accredited version. A strip of figures below traces the symbol through achievement, revelation and community.
practical_value: Choose the full accredited lockup for a program’s initial communication and keep its name attached to the common mark.
